in_marathi.name: Bablu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bablu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Hindi word ‘baba’, meaning ‘father’, Bablu is a diminutive form used to refer to a little boy or a dear one.
